description: Services and ports Aetheris checks on every IP. Each entry is a network service that can produce Low, Medium, High or Critical findings. A scan checks exactly the enabled ports; nothing else. Version 1.1 adds the services a Nexpose 'Full audit' commonly reports on that 1.0 did not cover (for example Intel AMT, SLP, X11, ActiveMQ, Solr, Hadoop, etcd, iSCSI, Domino, SAP, MikroTik, TR-069).
